Tired of dating apps, surface-level conversations, and events that don’t reflect where you are in life?
This South Asian Singles Mixer is designed specifically for marriage-minded professionals who value intention, emotional maturity, and meaningful connection.
There are no timers, no rotations, and no forced pairings. Instead, we create a thoughtfully structured social experience that allows conversations to flow naturally — in a relaxed, respectful, and well-hosted environment.

Event Flow

6:30 PM – 7:00 PM | Icebreaker GamesWe’ll kick things off with fun, low-pressure icebreaker games such as Never Have I Ever and Bare Minimum.
These activities are designed to help everyone relax, laugh, and start conversations naturally.

7:00 PM – 9:00 PM | Open Speed DatingGuests will speak with one person at a time in a relaxed, open speed-dating format. Every 12 minutes, the host will ask everyone to switch and start a conversation with someone new.
This keeps the experience structured and interactive while giving you enough time to see whether there is a genuine connection.
